description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this spacious six-bedroom student house on Ripon Gardens, Jesmond.

Offering plenty of room for a group of students, the property boasts six well-proportioned double bedrooms, two bathrooms and generous communal living space, making it ideal for both socialising and relaxing.

Situated in a popular residential area, the property is conveniently located close to Jesmond Dene and a range of local amenities, with easy access to both central Jesmond and Newcastle City Centre. Combining spacious accommodation with a convenient location, this property is an excellent choice for students looking for a comfortable home.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today!
